The New York Times and its staff work day in and day out to shield Israel from accountability of their crimes against the Palestinian people. 

🎥: Protest of A Private Reception for NYT Opinion Columnist Bret Stephens at Touro University, March 24, 2025

Here are just a few headlines of Bret Stephens articles in which he works to garner support for Israel: 
“Israel Had the Courage Do do What Needed to be Done” (June 13, 2025)
“We Should Want Israel To Win” (Oct. 8, 2024)
“A Hostage Deal is a Poison Pill for Israel” (Sept. 3, 2024) 

Shame on Bret Stephens. Shame on The New York Times. We must continue to hold them accountable for their role in the gen / cide in Palestine. 

Stop paying for lies. Unsubscribe from the New York Times now! ⚠️ 
Tri-State residents: We’re mobilizing. DM to show up. 🇵🇸 #RetractYourLiesNYT
